item.title: Motiva buys cargo of Venezuelan heavy oil for March delivery; first purchase since 2019
item.description: Other U.S. refiners, including Valero Energy, Phillips 66 and Citgo Petroleum, have also bought Venezuelan oil cargoes since the U.S.-Venezuela pact began, and are preparing to boost Venezuelan oil processing at their refineries.

item.title: Republic Services brings Upper Rock landfill RNG facility online
item.description: Republic Services, in partnership with Ameresco, has brought a 5.2-MW RNG facility online at the Upper Rock Island County Landfill in East Moline, Illinois.

item.title: How the construction industry is confronting mental health and suicide prevention
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with Pete Ielmini about the growing mental health crisis in construction and why suicide prevention must become part of the industry’s core safety culture.

item.title: When the clock is ticking: What Gulf Coast turnarounds reveal
item.description: As Gulf Coast plants enter turnaround season, operators are treating shutdowns as strategic events. Integrated planning, digital visibility and coordinated field work help cut risk, protect uptime and boost reliability before peak summer demand.

item.title: Solving structural challenges through cold rolling
item.description: Bendco Houston Pipe Benders offers cold rolling for pipe, tubing and structural steel, handling aggressive bends without heat. Its in-house flexibility supports industrial and construction projects with precise, install-ready curved components.

item.title: Exxon, TotalEnergies output at risk from Iran war, analysts say
item.description: The conflict has forced the shutdown of some oil and gas fields in ​the region and effectively halted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Hut 8 to fund water, power upgrades in West Feliciana for $2.8B data center
item.description: Hut 8 expects to initially create 1,000 temporary construction jobs and 200 full-time operations jobs, with operations scheduled to begin Oct. 1, 2026 and full commissioning expected within six months.

item.title: How Management Controls is driving contractor compliance across industries
item.description: Jeremy Osterberger speaks with Chrissy Jacobson of Management Controls about her role in the Future Leaders program and how the initiative is helping emerging professionals grow their networks across the industry.

item.title: Chevron ordered to suspend production at Leviathan gas field offshore Israel
item.description: The government said Israel's energy needs would be met through alternative sources and that the electricity sector was prepared to operate power stations using alternative fuels if necessary.
